The Times (London) reported on a Tuesday story that FIFA President Gianni Infantino (SUI) received not only a multi-million-dollar salary from FIFA, but an undisclosed second salary from the Coral Gables, Florida-based World Cup 2026 organizing committee:. “In 2024, Infantino was stated by Fifa’s annual report as earning 4.274m CHF (£3.88m).

news.title: James and Russo lead rout of Greece as ruthless England set up Ukraine playoff
news.lede: Playoff semi-final second leg: England 5-0 Greece (agg 8-1). Goalscorers: Russo 3 75, James 16 34, Stanway 30. A mercurial Lauren James scored two and provided an assist in a thrilling four-goal first 45 minutes against Greece, as England put themselves two games away from securing their place at the World Cup. James’s double was matched by Alessia Russo, who scored either side of the break, and her Arsenal teammate Georgia Stanway was also on the scoresheet, with the Lionesses setting up a playoff final against Ukraine in November and December.

news.title: England 5-0 Greece (8-1 on aggregate): Alessia Russo, Lauren James star as Lionesses cruise into World Cup play-offs second round
news.lede: Alessia Russo and Lauren James reiterated their importance to England as both scored twice in a 5-0 win against Greece in the second leg of their World Cup play-off first-round tie, winning 8-1 on aggregate. In fact, it was the Chelsea forward who supplied the Arsenal No 9 for an early opener - needed after a laborious 3-1 in Crete on Friday gave the Lionesses plenty to consider. But once England had taken the lead at the King Power Stadium they did not look back. James doubled the hosts' lead with a rocket effort before Georgia Stanway's bullet header made it three after Lauren Hemp's cross.

news.title: Former Arsenal boss Wenger touted as challenger to Infantino as Fifa boss
news.lede: Gianni Infantino could face a challenge for the presidency of Fifa, world football’s governing body, after reports on Tuesday that former Arsenal manager Arsène Wenger is preparing to stand for the post. Issued on: 13/10/2026 - 21:29Modified: 13/10/2026 - 21:31. British newspapers The Times, reported that Wenger, 76, who is Fifa’s chief of global football development, had been approached by senior figures in football about standing against Infantino, who has faced criticism since the 2026 World Cup. In August, Wenger said he had not been involved in a Fifa plan, since withdrawn, to sell stakes in future World Cup profits to private investors.

news.title: Road to World Cup: Filipinas beat Peru in friendly
news.lede: CHINCHA ALTA – The Philippine Women’s National Football Team had a hot start to beat Peru, 2-0, in an international friendly at the FPF La Videnita here, as part of the team’s preparation for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Brazil. Camryn Penn scored in the 20th minute for her first international goal, and Mallie Ramirez doubled the lead in the 42nd for her fourth. Dionesa Tolentin set up both goals with aggressive crosses from the right. The Filipinas created chances early.

news.title: Portugal vs Northern Ireland: Women's World Cup Qualifier second leg
news.lede: Highlights: Northern Ireland fall to Portugal after bright start. Northern Ireland's dreams of qualifying for their first World Cup came to an end as Portugal came from behind to beat Michael McArdle's side in Portimao. Despite being 4-0 down from the first leg at Inver Park, Northern Ireland took the lead on the night when Kess Elmore netted on her first start before Carolina Santagio equalised in the 45th minute. Jessica Silva edged Portugal ahead on the night when she chested home a cross on 74 minutes and Carole Costa added to their tally in the final 10 minutes from the penalty spot.

news.title: World Cup to be shown on new platform in groundbreaking deal - but United Kingdom miss out
news.lede: The worldwide streaming giants will broadcast all 104 matches of the tournament, including both semi-finals and the final. Such a deal marks a significant progression in how football is aired to fans as television companies have dominated the market. With Spain being a co-host and the reigning champions, Netflix said they will offer a 'distinctly Spanish perspective' on their shows. Fans in the country and its neighbours Andorra will be able to watch one match per matchday for free on the digital platform.

news.title: Netflix secures 2030 World Cup rights in Spain and Andorra
news.lede: Netflix has acquired the broadcasting rights for the 2030 FIFA World Cup in Spain and Andorra, the platform announced on Tuesday. Under the deal, the streaming service will show all 104 of the tournament's matches live. The 2030 World Cup is scheduled to take place across Morocco, Portugal, and Spain, with three special centenary celebration matches also set to be held in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay. The move marks a significant step in Netflix's strategy to expand its portfolio of live sports events and to compete with traditional television broadcasters.
